h1: Plate rollers and plate rolling machines
intro: A plate roller (plate rolling machine) bends flat plate or sheet into cylinders and cones by passing it between three or four rolls. Every ISITAN and NovoTech premium-line plate roller NovoTech sells in Canada: hydraulic 4-roll plate rolling machines with NC control for production, hydraulic and motorized 3-roll plate rollers for the fabrication shop, and motorized slip rolls for HVAC and sheet-metal work — from a 3.4 ft slip roll to 20 ft heavy-duty machines that roll 3-3/8″ plate. Built in Turkey by ISITAN (since 1959) and for the NovoTech premium line, supplied with CSA-approved panels and supported from NovoTech's warehouse in Mississauga, ON, Canada. Looking for a plate roller machine, sheet metal roller, slip roller or plate bending rolls? These are the ones we stock and service.

faq.q: Plate roller, plate roll, slip roll, bending rolls — are these the same machine?
faq.a: Largely yes. "Plate roller", "plate rolling machine" and "plate bending rolls" all describe the three- or four-roll machine that rolls flat plate into cylinders and cones; "slip roll" or "sheet metal roller" is the light-gauge version for sheet up to about 14 ga, whose top roll slips open to remove the part. We use the manufacturer's terms on each page so you can match them to the capacity tables.

faq.q: How do I choose the size of a plate roller?
faq.a: Three numbers: the longest cylinder you roll (working length), the thickest plate you roll at that length, and the smallest diameter you need. Plate rolls are rated at 1.5× and 5× the top roll diameter — a machine that rolls 1/4″ plate into a 20″ cylinder will not roll 1/4″ into a 10″ cylinder. Send us those three numbers and we will point to the models on the capacity tables.

faq.q: Which plate rollers does NovoTech keep in stock?
faq.a: We stock the popular MRM-S motorized rolls in Mississauga, ON, Canada, and bring 4R HMS and MRM-H hydraulic machines in to order with their options. In-stock machines carry the 7-day money-back guarantee.

faq.q: Do you install plate rollers and train operators?
faq.a: Yes — our technicians commission the machine anywhere in Canada, level it, check the roll parallelism and train your operators on pre-bending, cones and the NC control where fitted.

faq.q: What voltage do ISITAN plate rollers run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models whose main motor is 2.2 kW (3 HP) or less — a machine with a motor above 2.2 kW must run on three-phase power and cannot be converted to 240 V single-phase.
